t: Can You Buy Your Way Into Harvard?
s: October 24, 2018 - There are a few students—call them the Malala Yousafzais of the world—that are practically guaranteed admission to the college of their choice, but for the vast majority of a school like Harvard’s incoming class, once a student reaches a certain threshold of excellence, their admission or rejection is effectively a toss-up. You may be able to buy your way onto the ‘Dean’s Interest List’ or ‘Director’s List’ — but you can’t buy your way into Harvard.
